data.headline: Full-stack development for real-time energy dashboards
data.summary: They build full-stack dashboards for grid operators using TypeScript, React, Java and Spring Boot. They troubleshoot data imports, configure monitoring, test software, review code and gather feedback from operators.

signals.rendering: They develop full-stack web applications using TypeScript and React on the front end and Java with Spring Boot on the back end.
They use TypeScript and React to build front ends for dashboards showing electricity consumption in real time.
They use Java with Spring Boot for back-end development.
They diagnosed silent nightly import failures by adding logging and wrote a parser supporting both supplier CSV date formats.
They configured Grafana alerts to notify the team when meter data imports failed again.
They observe grid operators using dashboard screens every two weeks and work with a UX designer.
They review code for two junior developers on their team.
They use PostgreSQL and Docker in their development work.
They deploy applications to Azure with GitHub Actions.
They use tests to check their work, including coverage of the meter data import service.
They build real-time electricity consumption dashboards used by grid operators.

roles: Full-stack developer in energy or climate tech
